test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the amount provided per year to the farmers holding up to 2 hectre under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Siddhi (PMKSS)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6000 Rupees**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Every farmer gets Rs **6,000 per year** which is transferred every year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 each over four months.
 
• PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi for **financial assistance to needy farmers**.
 
• Earlier, the income support was given only to farmer families having cultivable land of up to **2 hectares**.
